request.style: English, bright folk, female solo voice with gentle choir, acoustic guitar, light percussion, flute, warm, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
She sent for Barak son of Abinoam
From Kedesh in Naphtali land
Go to Mount Tabor she commanded
Take ten thousand men at her hand

[Chorus]
Rise up Barak and lead
Away your captives it is said
Son of Abinoam stand tall
The Lord will make the enemy fall

[Verse]
Sisera heard the news arrive
Nine hundred iron chariots drive
From Harosheth to Kishon stream
The battle drums began to scream

[Chorus]
Rise up Barak and lead
Away your captives it is said
Son of Abinoam stand tall
The Lord will make the enemy fall

[Bridge]
The LORD routed Sisera down
By the edge of the sword he fell
Barak pursued the fleeing foe
Not one man of the army left

[Chorus]
Rise up Barak and lead
Away your captives it is said
Son of Abinoam stand tall
The Lord will make the enemy fall

[Outro]
Awake awake and break into song
Rise up Barak and lead along
